feed.title: Consumers allege P&G, Arm & Hammer ‘unscented’ deodorants contain fragrance
feed.summary: Two separate class action lawsuits have been filed against Church & Dwight Co. Inc. and The Procter & Gamble Company, alleging that their "unscented" deodorants actually contain fragrance ingredients.
